bio: Kristof Coppens lets his imagination run riot as he endeavours to source and exalt produce from all over the world, combining, enhancing and respecting each ingredient’s intrinsic qualities. For example, classical flavours find their way onto the menu, providing they can be paired with his creative recipes. The wine list is a treasure trove of tipples from Italy, Spain and France. A bijou eatery if ever there was!...
